t: If you give me some Spark energy, I'll consider it.
Books? What do I get in exchange? Spark energy, perhaps? At least three measures.

Do you doubt me? Didn't I put an end to Sarn and the Architect by pitting them against each other? I'm doing the same now - bringing together these madmen who rejected the gods, Hiero's Paladins who never question their own righteousness, and Hirkalla's minions who swore allegiance to the Darkness! They will weaken each other, and we will achieve our goals.

Some believe that victory can be achieved without getting your hands dirty, that there is always a simple and honest solution... But not me... And not you. You must understandmust understand - sometimes it's necessary to do things that are not... quite right.

You don't need Hirkalla - I will resurrect the dead myself just as I resurrected the Aviaks and the Tekyan. I will restore this world... my world! Not her.
Glad to hear it! But this choice will affect the future, so you need to be absolutely sure of it!
You won't regret it! Now listen carefully...
It pains me to hear this... But I'll ask again. This choice will affect the future, so you need to be absolutely sure of it!
I think you'll regret this... Get out of my sight! Go to her...
This Cathedral is an eyesore... It's time for some architectural improvements!

Hah! Haven't you heard? Pechorin made a deal with me - I give him my sister, Squirrel, and he helps me steal the rhino from Brick! A girl in exchange for a rhino - it's the sweetest deal I've ever made! Well, goodbye!
Oh, I could use a little pick-me-up...

t:
Is she dead? Dead?

Boring. I hoped that under the bullets boredom could not exist – a vain hope! In a month I grew so accustomed to the buzzing of the bullets and to the proximity of death that, to tell the truth, I paid more attention to the gnats – and I became more bored than ever. If I must die, I must! The loss to the world will not be great; and I myself am already downright weary of everything. I am like a guest at a ball, who yawns but does not go home to bed, simply because his carriage has not come for him. But now the carriage is here...My soul is corrupted by light: my imagination is restless, and my heart is insatiable. To me everything is of little moment. I become as easily accustomed to grief as to joy, and my life grows emptier day by day.

My destiny was stolen, you say? Well, perhaps. Once I was a different person. Then despair was born within my breast – not that despair which is cured at the muzzle of a pistol, but the cold, powerless despair concealed beneath the mask of amiability and a good-natured smile. I became a moral cripple. One half of my soul ceased to exist; it dried up, evaporated, died, and I cut it off and cast it from me. I vaguely remember something...

I met a stranger who said something to me... If only I could bring that moment back...

Well, if you need help, call me. Next? We'll go home to wash down our grief with a glass of tea... You can see how it all turned out.
It's simple - call on me for help, and I shall answer. If things get too hot, I'll call on my comrades. Together we'll defeat all foes!
Well, that's good! It's time for the second part of the plan.
Now we can go! I almost asked Hirkalla myself... Call me Sevia by the way. That's my real name...
Oh, an uninvited guest! I've been waiting for you... What news do you bring?

Oh, interesting news indeed! I... can't believe I'll see Nezeb... almost half a century later...

I should probably change... He won't recognize me in this...

You know, once we... But never mind that!

Help me find something suitable... I haven't opened these chests in a while... I'll refresh my binding spells for the jinns.
It's very lovely, but I believe we'll have to do some fighting first. A ball gown is a tempting choice, but let's not get ahead of ourselves.
Who do you take me for?! Honestly, I don't even know where it came from...
That's a bit too dark! We are reviving him, not burying!
Excellent! Exactly what I need. I was once a commander of Nezeb's Falcons. When I stepped down, Vlad took over...

The same way you got to the Cave of Wonders on Suslanger - I'll create an experimental portal. I don't want to use the secret trails right now - it will take too long without the Wanderer, and we'll end up next to the Well anyway.

It will be harder to get to the deep Astral, but that can wait.
I'll teleport us straight to the Fodiator! Then I'll use the Seal as a ritual table. You and the jinns will cover me. You won't even need to leave the ship.

SirMadam !

There is no passage! By order of our empress, a barricade has been installed here to prevent dark creatures from entering the city and attacking her subjects!

Wait for her instructions. She will deal with these creatures soon. After that we will dismantle the barricades.

What else? Would you like to serve me, ? Excellent. Speak with my generals - they will have plenty of tasks for you. If you earn enough respect, you will be rewarded.

We won't let anyone out of the city for now - it's too dangerous. These creatures are everywhere... I'll deal with most of it, but it will take time, but for now the barricades will remain in place.

Await further instructions.
Sarn created perfect destroyers. That's exactly what I need. With them, I can change the whole universe!
He's just lying around... Should I read the news to him? Or make dinner? There is nothing in the pantry. Just the pudding...
Self-conceit ought to be the very salt of life. Look at you, running back and forth. I'm good here...
Get up yourself if you need to... Why must we hurry? Surely we can wait and do it all later...
Ugh, I am sick and tired of your pudding...
He's in a bad way today. Normally he would eat breakfast, scold me... But today he just lies there...
Foodstuffs! They are not quite fresh or appetizing, but they are fine for ghosts! Take your pick! Before they go to waste!

Ugh, I wish I could sell it to you, but look around you! These nihilists showed up, yelling and breaking everything. Scared away all my customers, you're the only one left. Please get rid of them! Deal?
That's very interesting... These creatures are not from our world...

These Dark Maidens are emotional parasites who feed on fear and other strong emotions. They say they came from the world of Tantibo, all thanks to Hirkalla... As the Goddess of Darkness, she probably knows how to control them.

We should talk to her... Let her explain what's going on. If the Dark Maidens are stealing fates, Hirkalla should know about it.

Like a weight has been lifted off my chest...

I've been lying here too long... My fate was stolen, you say? Is fate something that can be stolen? I don't know...

Alright, I'll go for a walk. Call if you need me.

You see, I have considerable connections, so rest assured that the nobility will immediately hear of all your noble exploits that I will witness. Which will improve your reputation!

The ghouls have become loud again. Go there and summon me by using my calling card. Then give them a good thrashing in my presence. Your reputation will improve within a minute!

Around the city, shady people

Hid treasures in chests.

And in those chests, there is a double bottom

Or a false wall...

Valuables are inside.

I figured out those secrets

And I am ready to help you.

I will get the reward out of the chest.

Do you want an example? There is a chest

Not far from here.

I'll mark it on the map.

Go there and summon me. We'll open it together.

I suppose we should join Hiero and his Paladins at the Cathedral on Jigran. Their faith is so strong that they were able to create a protective barrier around the temple.

At the research institute, we have created a device that will allow us to travel to Jigran undetected.

But first, let's pray, . And ask the Light for guidance...
You are an aberration in the fabric of existence. A blot. A mistake! And I will fix this mistake!
I'm the one following in your footsteps! Beware, for I am close... You will not escape Fate, !
Not me... The Scissors... The power you let into our world! You played with fate without thinking about the consequences. I couldn't save her. But beware, the scissors are coming for you, !
Today you see a heartbroken father. I'm very worried about my daughter... She is in trouble. My daughter went on a long walk... And disappeared!

, we have learned a lot over the year and can say for certain that the Goddess of Darkness is not omniscient and not omnipotent. Her strength is limited; she is unable to keep track of everything.

But she is dangerous. Her minions are everywhere, especially here in Novograd. Therefore we will proceed with extreme caution. Our task is to get to a place where she has no power.

, I suppose we should join Hiero and his Paladins at the Cathedral on Jigran. Their faith is so strong that they were able to create a protective barrier around the temple.

My brother sent us a device that will allow us to travel to Jigran undetected.

But first, let's pray. And ask the Light for guidance...

I can't contain myself... I am in love! In love! Alas, she is noble, rich, and she cannot belong to me! At that terrible moment, when I learn that I'm not destined to possess her, there's only one thing left to do: die...
Oh, it's a simple game... You take a card, I take a card, then another if you need it. If you have more points, you win, but if you get more than 21, you lose.
Playing with fate is a dangerous thing, but playing with luck is even more dangerous!
Exciting! What could be more important?
Oh, it's a simple game... You take a card, I take a card, then another if you need it. If you have more points, you win, but if you get more than 21, you lose.
You have a nine. The total is 13 points.
You have a Jack. It counts as 10, so you have 23. That's too much. I have 16. I win! Let's go again?
Just 13? I have 16, I win! Let's go again?
You have a six. The total is 16.
You have a three! Looks like luck is on your side this time! You got 19! I only had 17, I should have taken a risk and drawn another card... you win!
16? Not bad! But not enough to win! I have 17! Let's go again?
You have a Jack. Wow, 21! Luck smiles on you! I have 18. You win.

Ah, it's a family legend! My grandmother, Countess Golitsyna, was once considered a great beauty... Even the Great Magician Elleken himself was in love with her. But alas - my grandmother preferred cards to love. One day, she happened to lose in a big way... And then, in exchange for one date, Elleken revealed to her the "secret of the three cards"...

However, he did so on condition that she would not tell others about it... Alas, she could not keep her promise - she told the secret to her husband and lover... And then, Elleken appeared to her and said,

"You will receive a fatal blow from the one who, while being madly in love, will come to ask you about the three cards."

Every living being, be it a human, elf, orc, animal, or even demon, has a Spark. No one knows what it actually is. You can call it a visible soul.

Free Sparks cannot linger too long in our world - they continually lose energy, fading over time.

In his time, Tep learned to extract it from Sparks. If you catch them, you can take what you need and use it for various purposes.

Hhirkalla released all Sparks from the storage that was similar to Tep's Pyramid.

That's why Jigran is full of free energy right now.
Hehehe... Didn't you know that casino always wins?
Ah! What impudence... Well... I lost a little, it happens... Here, take it...
Do you expect me to just give it to you? What if I beat you up?
Honestly, why does everyone expect from me what they don't expect from others? There is no evil and good, just prejudice...
I was afraid of the abyss of wisdom...
Ooh, a casino... Everyone plays cards there, right? I really want to go, but I'll need to find a chaperone!
Casino? Hmm, interesting! Well, now I'm gonna go pray and maybe I will, at least to see what's going on over there....
Oh, really! It's quite boring here, time for a change of scenery! I'm going to the casino! I need a carriage!
But who are you? What do you want?

Lisa is more precious to me than anything else in the world! But I am poor, and she is rich! The heiress of a noble family... I'm no match for her, no match at all... But if I were rich... Then everything would be different!
Oh god, oh god! Is she... dead?
I came to you against my will, but I was ordered to fulfill your request. Let Herman save Lisa, marry her... And three cards, three cards, three cards will win.
I knew the price of Elleken's secret would be my life... I was not destined to be resurrected again, so tomorrow I will leave this world for good...

So that's why he's here! Not for me! He wanted to know the three cards! It wasn't me he wanted, it was the cards...

Oh my God, oh my God! I loved him...! Monster! Murderer! Fiend!

I didn't want this, I only wanted to know about the three cards...!

She's dead, but I still don't know the secret! She's dead! It came true...! But I didn't learn the secret! What do I do now?

Yes, I'm poor... Without a coin to my name... The three cards were my chance, but I missed it... I'm scared! So scared! It's here! The Countess's ghost! She has come for me!
I didn't kill her, it was an accident!
If you want me to go somewhere, I need {price} measures of Spark energy... Because I'm very sleepy... The local fumes are draining my life force...
No, I can't do that yet...
Why? I'm not going anywhere, I'm studying the local fauna which passes from a ghostly state to a fleshly state.
No, sorry, I have no desire to walk through the swamps – it's too easy to drown around here... Why would I?
I can't do that. I'm a male elf. And I'm not a servant.
Well, how do I explain this... There is certainly a difference...
It's flattering, of course, but I think your old lady will notice the difference...
Ah, once upon a time... But it happened so long ago...
I have no energy for this! If I could have {price} measures of Spark energy, I'll go...
No, I can't do that yet...
It looks like the elf is dead... The Countess's ghost will be very unhappy about this. We need to think of something, find some kind of replacement...

quests: Before the swamps swallow them up

t:
Queen of spades! That's her... the Countess! Damn it!

Three, seven, ace! Three, seven, queen...!
Yes, the secret is mine. I'm going to win!
Greetings to you, my dear friend!

It's curious indeed.

Yes, there are mentions here...

Of a missing daughter...

Lost and forgotten,

But that's all there is.

The details are vague.

Is that speaking of her,

Or of another, altogether...

And that's just a part of the records!

The remaning part, though

Is hidden in the Sardrok Palace
My remember dis thing. My let human pass!
Greetings to you! The Junes will have their vengeance!
Why are you standing here? What are you looking at? You don't respect your elders! You should listen to your elders!

Ohh... Aaah... *sob* I can't... I can't stand her...

She keeps berating me... *sob* my mother-in-law...

Ohh... *sob* they married me off to a man I didn't love! *sob* This is no living with her! I'm a disgrace to the family now... *sob* I wish I'd died...
*sob* You can't... You can't help me... Go away...
Oh, Oak, what is this? Why...

It was under this oak tree that it all happened. I cried so much and hurt myself... I can't escape this sin. I can't escape it. It's not good, it's a terrible sin that I love another. Where can I go? Who can help me? My God, I am perishing! I don't need anything, and the light of God no longer matters to me! And death would not come. You call for it, but it does not come. It would be better if I was struck by lightning and killed on the spot.
Maybe I should ask the healer for advice? She is wise... she knows a lot... Maybe she can help me... Go, I beg you, ask... I won't go myself... I'm ashamed...

So there are other lands beyond our borders! How amazing! And we sit here knowing nothing. It's good that there are kind people: every now and then you hear what's going on in the world, otherwise we would die like fools.

quests: Good Deeds for the City: Fixing Fences

t:
Ah, that dog... It's a pity, yes... But...

I must say the dogs you brought me eat less than she does... and they don't try to eat me! I suppose getting a hound from the Wild Hunt wasn't the best idea...
Oh, that thunder! Something will happen today, I'm sure of it...

The storm gave me power... And... I liked that power!

Jigran is full of powerful sorceresses and goddesses who don't need to listen to their parents, their husband's relatives, or their elders in general! For example, Hirkalla! Did she listen to her mother-in-law? Maybe I should join her? Why not!

If I'm going to serve, then I'll serve a great woman, not this cruel merchant's wife!

I wished for this thunderstorm to kill me so I wouldn't suffer any more. But this thunderstorm has given me a new life.

My soul feels so light!

I believe this will be a lesson to us all.

Heavy clouds often gather over those who live someone else's destiny, someone else's life. The storm will break sooner or later. Sometimes it kills. And someone becomes a storm themselves and destroys everything that prevents them from living.

You should keep this in mind and pay attention to the clouds gathering over you and your loved ones.

I admit I'm glad that Katerina chose this path - it's a destructive one, but it's a path of life.

And Martha can rebuild her house.
I suspected we were getting closer to her... Sometimes you can tell that someone's fate was changed very recently... However, she is no longer here. We should check one more "odd person out".

You know, you seem like an intelligent creature to me. Think about it - what fate? What is fate, anyway? Someone out there decided who everyone would be, and we have no choice in the matter?

That's my mother's nonsense that she put into people's heads. Things like "Fate itself determined your destiny: you, Hirkalla, you naughty child, will fiddle with the dead, but your little sister gets flowers and bunnies. Now accept it and don't complain."

Nonsense! I choose my own path. And no one can tell me what to do!

Let me explain in simple terms. My sister is deceitful from top to toe. I know you've been in regular contact with her. She always comes up with something, trying to manipulate everyone, inventing all sorts of schemes...

Now she is stalling for time - until the forces of other gods, supporters of the All-Mother, arrive in Sarnaut. That's why she created some new legend that she fed you after your adventures in the land of cute fluffy Gibberlings. But I will give you the truth.

There are two forces - me and my enemies. I'm talking about these bigoted fanatics in their Cathedral, which I can't reach yet. Help me end them - I will give you everything you want. Do you want to rule the Empire? Tomorrow Yasker will look for a new job. Do you want countless treasures? I will build you a city of gold. Reveal all the secrets of the world? Zayan will ask you to teach him.

Open your eyes!

It's the Light! There is only one road for them - the road of "good" which they defined for themselves, giving themselves the right to judge and punish.

They will not listen to your arguments, they decided everything for themselves long ago, and their decision will not change. As soon as you disagree with them on something, you are their enemy.

Their Light is not mercy, it's justice! Cruel and merciless. They see us all as a crowd of savages approaching their sparkling city on the hill. Like a jungle that wants to destroy the garden they created. How do they deal with the jungle? They clear it away.

Very good. I knew you were a smart boygirl.

Follow the instructions of my faithful generals... By the way, I owe you for them, so thank you. While you are at it, you can find out more about these "odd people out", since they interest you so much.

Nihaz summoned me from a very distant world where Light and Darkness are ensnared in an eternal conflict.

The Lord of Light was skillful, and it allowed him to create magic rings. He gave three of them to the dark alvs, seven to the black dvergs, and another nine to free humans. He also secretly created the One Ring - it was supposed to lead all these peoples to the Light.

And then my four dark brothers and I arrived in this world to roam the earth, confuse the minds of its inhabitants, and turn them to Darkness.

These rings did a lot of good. After death, their bearers turned into angelic spirits, but the forces of Darkness managed to create a powerful alliance of dark alvs and human necromancers which opposed the Lord of Light. He was defeated, and his Ring was lost.

Later it was found by a halfling. He put it on - and was transformed. He founded a monastery and began to preach, convincing his brethren to follow the path of Light...

Then another halfling, a notorious rogue, managed to steal the Ring from him.

One day, after a drinking binge arranged by the thief, I discovered that this stolen ring was the very same Ring of Light. I decided to destroy it. I entrusted four most inveterate halfling bandits with carrying it. I also chose an impostor who wanted to become a king, a treasure-hungry dverg, and an arrogant alv who considered everyone else to be scum. One of the warriors of the main state of human necromancers also went with them, but the Light led him astray, and they had to deal with him.

Despite the betrayal of one of my brothers who went over to the side of the Light, my squad of scoundrels successfully reached the Sparkling Crystal Mountain and threw the Ring into its depths. The Lord of Light was destroyed. Later, my comrades and I left this world and joined Nihaz. For thousands of years I have been traveling around the worlds, aiding him to the best of my humble ability.
Ah, my friend! Misfortune is a contagious disease. The unfortunate and poor need to stay away from each other so as not to get any worse.
There is no need to get involved in other people's troubles. If you take it all to heart, it's no wonder you are the most unhappy person out there.

My friend, we all need Sparks, because in this city it's impossible to exist without paying for our existence... I'm a poor girl, so it was worth dying for this chance.. It's a shame it didn't work out. I won't say any more, I'm afraid they'll destroy me completely.
I don't want to study, I want to get married. Mother!
Just piss off! What is wrong with you? Say another word! I'll kick your ass!
Go away! Go away! I'm so tired of you, people... Opiskin got lucky! Next time I'll win and get rich. There will be more Sparks than candy wrappers. Mother!
Eh, I was super passionate as a young woman. Few men could handle me.
For me there is no light, no darkness, no bad, no good, no boredom, no joys. I didn't understand anything, didn't love anyone and didn't love myself...

Ah, this eternal poverty, a husband I didn't love, and an ardent lover! Why do you care about someone else's fate? But this is the first and last time I participated in something like this. I'd rather die of hunger.

The laws of nature are simple and unpretentious - hares eat grass, wolves eat hares.

Who are you in this cycle?
You don't look like a "hare", sirmadam, the shade of your skin indicates the opposite.

In that case, let me warmly welcome you to my hunting grounds.

But a wolf, as you know, hunts in a pack. Your face is unfamiliar to me, which means you are not part of the pack.

Hahaha! Very funny!

But you are right, on Jigran any living soul can become food for another... less living one.

The pack will gladly accept you if you make a modest contribution to the budget of the upcoming hunt. Organizing it incurs certain expenses.

It just so happens that hares are found only where grass grows abundantly.

A mere trifle, just twenty Sparks.

Believe me, it's a symbolic payment for the pleasure you will receive, brothersister.

"Hares" are resurrected residents who have negligible means of subsistence. They are in desperate need of juicy fresh grass. Sparks, that is.

And then it's us – the "wolves". We have what the "hares" need - you yourself have made a generous contribution. This amount became part of the main prize which will go to the fastest bunny.

I just help the "hares" and "wolves" give each other what they need.

"Wolves" and "hares" receive special masks from me. Thanks to them, our glorious hunt can take place in private, away from prying eyes and ears. Whoever takes off the mask leaves the hunt.

Then the "hares" run away and hide. The "wolves" look for "hares" and... well, you understand why wolves need hares, right?

The hunt ends when only one "hare" remains in the field. They receive all the juicy grass the "wolves" contributed to the hunting budget.

Rest assured, you will receive in full what you and I need in these lands inhabited by the dead and ghosts.

Fresh blood and the excitement of the hunt!

Oh. Yes. Unfortunately, the prey of wolves sometimes changes in sad ways. Don't worry about it. Cleaning up is my concern.

Here is your wolf mask. Happy hunting!
Interesting things are happening here, in Hirkalla's court...
They say there was once a necromancer on Jigran who loved to swing his sword. His name was Firez. I'd fight him in a fair fight...
I haven't seen anyone from Gipat here - not even the headman or Osip Bazhov... Where did they go? Are they all in the Village?
Nihaz instructed me to serve his daughter as loyally as I serve him... And even if I don't like what she does, I obey the Lord...

, this city is full of crazy people, each crazier than the last...

They told me about one officer. They say bullets can't hurt him, and he treats his own fate with complete indifference. He is not tempted by women or worldly fame, nothing interests him. Death also avoids him yet takes those who walk beside him more readily than others.

A police officer once shared this story with me. He read an article by an unknown student in a local newspaper. This student claims that there is a certain category of people who are not just allowed to commit crimes but should do so - they say their destiny is to become great, and everything will be justified in the end.

Pure madness, isn't it?

What? What do you mean, ? Everyone here is strange. They dress strangely and act strangely. I've already punched various dandies in the face for clowning around...

Curious, you say? Meaning funny?

I was told a story recently. There is some gentleman here who lies on the sofa all day. He doesn't do anything - he's too lazy. They tried everything to rouse him, but nothing worked. So he lies on that sofa, haha!

To me, every other one doesn't belong here... I don't know why they had to resurrect them all, ...

But there is one smart ass among them who, in my opinion, should be chucked off the Bridge of Time...

I met him by chance, at the local cemetery... He digs up corpses, practices black magic. We started a conversation, and then he said, "I don't recognize any authority, especially that of gods." Gods! Nihaz, our teacher and benefactor!

I was already furious, and he continued, "I reject everything, gods included." Ugh, I would have punished him if it weren't for the empress Hirkalla. And this scoundrel has followers! The so-called nihilists. They don't believe in the Light or Darkness.
I'm going to pass out... {price} measures of Spark energy can help me...
I feel so tired, my legs are dead. If I could have {price} measures of Spark energy, I'll go...
I feel weak... My arms and legs are so heavy... Perhaps you have {price} measures of Spark energy on you?
Oh, help me! These creatures are everywhere - they swarmed in from all directions...
Ooh, Anton Zagoretsky! Yes, I'm in!

t:
One will come out of the fire unharmed

If they spend a day with them,

Breathe the same air,

And preserve their sanity.

A vision suddenly appeared...

A monster drives us crazy...

Hiding in the shadows...

It is watching us, weaving a web...

Slay it, I pray! Otherwise...

How can you be so careless?

Here, take the Shadow Visor and don't lose it...

How can you be so careless?

Here is the amulet. Don't lose it...

Well, does that mean the deceiver has seen the light?

I don't blame her - she's young and naive.

I was foolish, got into an argument with a wrong person...

Molchalin is a scoundrel. But he got what he deserved.

My soul is gripped by sorrow,

And in the crowd I'm lost, I'm not myself.

Are you saying I have lost my destiny?

I felt... As though I had been torn... from my place,

Everything was so strange...

What did you say? "Odd people out"?

But very well. If you ever need help,

Just call me...

Like all the people of Jigran, my father

Wants a son-in-law with ranks and stars.

Oh, you brought him back?

Dear Chatsky... He was right.

We offended him.

Called him mad...

He is, of course, sarcastic...

But not unreasonably.

Are we working or playing tonight?

Alice: I awoke in a field full of the dead. Death and darkness ruled there. The despair that engulfed all living things was so great that it tore me from my sleep. I remembered nothing, and this was my first memory - the field of the last battle, full of the dead. There was only a feeling of monstrous darkness, the breath of death itself. All life here was destroyed. The darkness caused by powerful and cunning magic extinguished every bit of life.

Hirkalla: That's a lot of histrionics, sister.

Alice: But I had the strength to overcome the plague. I was a part of this world, and the plague was not. And I was able to get rid of it, throw it away - into oblivion. Then I buried all these warriors. I managed to find their homeland, far away from this now empty country, and I took their bodies home where they belonged. Their country was also devastated. Death reigned there now. The sand had already begun to cover their homes and fields. In a few years only memories would remain of them, and for many years anyone capable of feeling would stay away from this place, driven by the shadow of fear, the sense of unimaginable horror that had destroyed an entire civilization.

Hirkalla: Melodramatic. This kind of thing happens somewhere all the time. But fine, tell me more.

Alice: Of course, the Conclave was not infallible, and they often had to correct the consequences of ill-considered decisions. Their main temptation was created by Nihaz himself. The twelve keys of Power, locked in twelve towers that he erected shortly after he replaced the Guardian Dragons with Seals. At that time, I did not know about it, but as the Soul of the World, I understood that these objects were extremely dangerous.

Hirkalla: Divine energy. Giving it to mortals is the same as...

Alice: Letting children play with fire, yes. Nihaz deliberately gave these fragments of the Seals to the Great Mages, knowing that keeping Sarn contained would be difficult. Looking at the Junes, he knew how to tempt the inhabitants of this world and what would happen if he offered them power. He wanted to see how they would deal with Sarn and his creations. It was a gamble where he could lose, but that was exactly the kind of game Nihaz enjoyed.

Hirkalla: And have you grown fond of the mortals of this world, sister?

Alice: Of course…

Alice: What have you been doing all this time, sister? Nihaz never told me anything…

Hirkalla: My task was to gather the twelve powers of the gods. The mages of this world call them the Sources. These "domains" are extremely important and I couldn't leave them in unworthy hands. The darkness never had the brute force of Chaos. Or the fury of Light.

Alice: Darkness can be insidious, I know that better than anyone… You were able to beat Sarn…

Hirkalla: Our enemies were stupid and arrogant. So they soon paid for everything. Over time, we gathered more and more power with the help of what came to be called… technology. The All-Mother was wrong to underestimate such possibilities. Yes, we were not Creator Gods, we could not resurrect the dead with only our will. But these miracles became available thanks to the Citadels and the acquired knowledge.

Alice: Nihaz used amazing people to create them. They are still in Sarnaut.

Hirkalla: After acquiring all twelve powers, we decided to visit Eidos. The original world of the gods fell into our hands like an overripe fruit. Its few defenders fled when it was flooded by the boundless darkness. And we found what we were looking for - knowledge, the ability to remake existence according to our own desires.

Alice: And what happened next, sister? Did Nihaz give you power over the creatures of Darkness? What awaited you?

Hirkalla: Endless centuries of endless battles. Mortal empires rose and fell, worlds rose and fell. As always, chaos against order, darkness against light. Sarn fell, but his followers rallied. The Architect advanced like a glacier - he was unstoppable but extremely slow. Chaos raged in its fury but had no strategy. Nihaz's path and mine diverged. The one I called father entrusted me with this war, and I chose to strike suddenly and unpredictably where it was least expected. We brought death to our enemies - and many of their worlds were devastated. We undermined their resolve, offering the temptations of new rules and laws. There is nothing in the universe that we have not touched. In the end, they will all come to us or fall.

Alice: Was it fair, sister?

Hirkalla: Oh, how I hate them, the bright and righteous. They themselves made us the overlords of death and darkness, and now we will bring death and darkness to them. We need no mercy and we will show none.

Hirkalla: How did you finally regain your memory?

Alice: When Nihaz returned to this world. I was his beloved daughter who had found her forgotten relative. And I was happy. Nihaz, on the other hand, needed a new student. He tried many of the inhabitants of this world - Tep, Elleken, Ath-Zak. But they were all unsuitable. He needed someone who was...

Hirkalla: What were you going to say?

Alice: Who escaped their fate.

Alice: A representative of his people who will go where others were not destined to go.

Alice: Who would not back down from a challenge and would do the unthinkable.

Alice: And that hero came. They arrived in the Holy Land, uncovered Sarn's conspiracy and, after receiving Tensess's advice, went to the Coba Plateau.

Alice: There was something about them that others didn't have, and I realized it at first sight.

Alice: That was our first meeting.

Alice: And the second...

Alice: I stood near the carcass of a long-dead dragon, and as soon as I touched the heart this hero gave me, I immediately remembered.

Alice: I was a mortal sorceress who belonged to this world, and I found myself as a goddess who lost her immortality.

Alice: But I could get everything back, and I did.

Alice: After taking Tep's Spark, full of the power he had stolen, I performed many miracles, and the eyes of many believers turned to me. Faith returned my divinity, and memory helped me understand who Nihaz was.

Alice: But the hardest part was yet to come - I pitted Sarn and the Architect against each other, but our so-called "father" was able to avoid the trap.

Alice: To rid Sarnaut of him, I decided to join forces with our mother, but you and Nihaz were once again more cunning.

Alice: Then I decided to play with time. I tried to change the past. I tried thousands of options, but it all came down to one thing - my defeat.

Hirkalla: Playing with time is a dangerous game, sister.

Alice: But I learned a lot along the way, and I remembered what you had forgotten. The fate you regret was determined for you from above. These Threads are not spun by us, and it's not for the gods to determine their own fate.

Hirkalla: What are you even talking about, sister?

Alice: There are many forces in the universe. The enmity between light and darkness is only a small part of the universal confrontation, the clash of opposites. Our destinies are decided by need. By the one who determines the lot given to us.

Hirkalla: I still don't believe in fate. What do you think this is? Predestination?

Alice: It would like to be predestination, all-powerful and indisputable, but capricious Chance interferes with its plans.

Alice: The choice of fate for a god is not the same as the choice of fate for a mortal. It weighs on us more heavily than the vault of heaven on our shoulders, binds us tighter than the chains of a prisoner. Our existence is defined by our talent, and we are incapable of becoming different.

Sister, do you remember the fiery font to which our mother led us, the maidens weaving the threads, and the stern gaze of necessity that determined our destiny?

Hirkalla: You confuse dreams and reality, sister.

Alice: Sometimes a dream is more real. You forgot what you were originally, but I managed to regain what was lost.

Hirkalla: Being a mortal made you lose all sense of reason. You were mad before, and now even more so.

Alice: You are the last one to talk about madness. You reveled in your role as a destroyer of foundations - everything our mother built. Together with Nihaz, you became a nightmare for mortals, the harbingers of the end times. Do you deny it?

Hirkalla: No...

But first you need to hear the previous part.

Hirkalla: I'm lost in your madness. And what does chance decide?

Alice: Blind probability, the possibility of two outcomes. Chance led the hero found by Nihaz along their path. Luck accompanied them in their adventures. In one version, they died, but in the other, they survived and kept going. If not for chance, their path would have been cut short long ago... This is what I was able to see. Moreover, after becoming an element of chance, they now change the fates of others. Their skill allowed them to become a Weaver, one who is able to tie together previously severed Threads.

Hirkalla: Am I supposed to believe that it all means something? That it's not some wild superstitions of barbarian tribes?

Alice: I'm afraid I have no way to convince you, sister. However, beware - your fate is tied to their fate now, just like mine.

Alice: There is one more thing - in the confrontation between Predestination and Chance, beware of the Scissors. She is ready to cut all the Threads that do not fit into her vision of the Pattern... This force is already here...

Hirkalla: You tire me, sister. I fear your madness is incurable. Leave my city, you have no place here anymore!

Alice: If you don't listen, I will find those who will.

Hirkalla: You mentioned the burden of the gods, and therefore this is my burden. I am death, I am the guardian and ruler of the kingdom from which there is no return. But I am not an executioner who serves those unwilling to get their hands dirty. Yes, mortals died, but that is the price of change. The old order had to be overthrown so that a new, more just order could arise.

Alice: But you did not understand the truth that our adoptive father understood. Being a god, you are unable to deviate from your essence. You remain darkness and death, and are unable to become anything else.

Hirkalla: Are you saying you were able to change? Reject this very destiny that I don't believe in?

Alice: If you want, I can tell you what happened. I assume Nihaz kept this a secret from you?

Hirkalla: Do you think I was so interested in your fate that I asked about it? No, sister. After you left my kingdom, giving a life for a life, I stopped being concerned about you. But if so, tell me...

Alice: Well, my story will be long, but we have time...

Alice: But I didn't understand then that you and I are tied to our essence. Goddess of Life and Goddess of Death. Do you remember how, at the dawn of the world given to us, you tried to create, sister? How death, obedient to you, tried to turn into its opposite? What happened then?

Hirkalla: I often remember that moment. The night decided to become day, and the executioner and gravedigger became a sculptor and painter. But I was able to create something... even when I went against my nature.

Alice: Yes, the monster you created terrified mortals, and they called upon me. I stopped this creature and returned it to oblivion. It was a lesson you had to learn. My lesson began when I entered the Gate of the "Kingdom from which there is no return." The life that was my essence dried up like a spring in a season of drought. None of the gods would agree to die voluntarily without gaining anything. Because the gods are immortal, and that's what differs them from mortals.

Alice: The deceased king Sharuken was replaced by one of his confidants, and the priests got used to the fact that their beloved goddess stopped answering them. It was difficult for me, but I was able to find my place in the world of Urg which I once helped create. Now I looked at it with the eyes of a mere mortal. Days flew by, draining my spirit, and then one day I found myself in one of the city taverns which I had never been to before. And I met its owner.

Hirkalla: Nihaz?

Alice: Yes, it was him. A crafty wanderer who took the form of a man. I recognized him regardless. We talked for a long time, and I complained about my lot. After all, I greatly regretted what had happened then, I felt sorry for myself and the deceased Sharuken. I stopped being a goddess and now everything was meaningless. And Nihaz offered me a deal - an opportunity to change my fate. The price for this was my memory.

Hirkalla: He didn't tell me about this. However, your fate was of little interest to me, sister.

And who are you?

What an interesting little world you have here. You broke it thoroughly...

You want to know about the Tablets of Fate, don't you? About the one who is behind everything? But it's too early, Weaver... For you, everything is yet to come.
It's hard to find so many dark, harsh, and strange influences on one's soul as in Dar Ulgorn. Even the climate!
Whenever they have a problem, you start fretting over it like a hen with an egg! He never has time, everything annoys him - and he just lies there, doing nothing.
I have always looked for answers to a simple question: what is the meaning of this grand event that we call life? It cannot be that everything is meaningless...
Perhaps right now I'm closer than ever to getting answers to my questions...

I can't remember when I was full... I trembled over every piece of bread... I trembled all my life... I suffered... afraid to eat more than others... I walked around in rags all my life... my whole unhappy life... For what?
I was tempted by his money, but I swear I never imagined that he was such an unworthy man. If I had seen through him earlier, he wouldn't have tempted me!

Ah, most honorable sirlady!! Here you are... in our land... Well, let's talk, fathermother! Or maybe you don't like to be called most honorable sirlady and... fathermother...Please don't consider it familiarity...

t: I ended up here and now I can't get out... I can't get to the portal, I can't board the ship - no one even knows who I am or where I'm from...

I find the current situation outrageous! But that's fine. Soon we will bring back the nobility, soon we will return our ancient rights and put an end to this chaos! Soon the words "Valir" and "Kania" will mean something again!

Aho, frriend! Aho, friend! We on Howlem could not stand by when such great things were happening.

We have already seen the consequences of Hirkalla's actions when the Great Tree of Howlem began to wither and die, and our island began to collapse. We will not allow this to happen again, and if you need to free the All-Mother, we are ready.

t: The world is changing, isn't it? Changing irreversibly. People from the past are coming back, and they bring something new with them...

Oh, it's you again... And how do you like it in the capital of the Shadows? Nothing like Irene, right? Let's put aside old squabbles... Believe me, we have a lot in common now. Messere has achieved his goals, and now he is going his own way. He instructed us to ensure that Beauty does not leave Sarnaut entirely...
Each of us plays a role, one we choose ourselves or one that's chosen for us. Which role do you play?
Ooh, you're making progress... It's all part of the game, just a joke that's extremely funny. Understanding... is necessary.
Darkness has always been to my liking... You see, my mother is also the Queen of Darkness in a way, so... I like Hirkalla very much.
We are all here to play our parts. Do you understand what you have to do? Do you see your future? They told me that you are a Weaver. But a Weaver who does not see their Fate is blind.

They asked me to kill Hirkalla... An interesting target, but is it worth it...? No treasure in the world is enough to pay for my services... There are enough people in this city who can be killed... But hasn't murder become meaningless in a world where everyone is resurrected? I'm in doubt...

Ah, wonderful Light... I have already visited this majestic Cathedral where Hiero's followers gather... I would like to be with them, but how can I leave our troupe? And Pamina... She loves Darkness more. I hope you understand...

We are all brothers and sisters, poor wanderers from the House de Velund, forced to leave Irene... I hope everything will change soon, because I'm tired of wandering around the world, and since Messere left us, we are forced to do what Pulcinella wants...

Along with the world, its magic is also changing... Did you know that until recently Sarnaut was cut off from all flows from other worlds? And now there is a powerful goddess in the Heart of the World, and fragments of alien power have begun to reach us from the stars...
This is outrageous! I had a new coat, but they stole it... I don't know what to do now...
Dmitry, the scoundrel... Of course, he acted nobly then, in our first meeting, but now... And this woman...

One may live and yet be ignorant of the fact that under one's very nose there may be a book in which one's whole life is described as in a picture. Never should I have guessed that, as soon one begins to read such a book, they start to remember, consider, and foretell events.
I love to read, but I can't seem to find any new books...

Free me... from my husband! Take this noose off me... Wait! Don't be too hasty! You need to do everything quietly... Do you know my sister? Do you want to marry her? Do it. And I'll give you more money... rubles... three hundred! The more I can scrounge up, the more I'll give you...
I'd be very curious to look at a person who has the courage to believe in nothing.
A maple leaf, when it falls to the ground, looks like a butterfly, and it's strange - because the driest and deadest looks like the most lively creature out there.
I fight for women's rights - I swore to defend them to the last drop of blood. I cannot watch indifferently when women are attacked. It's terrible, terrible.
I give everyone a shiner, both the right and wrong - to keep order!
Ah, what a meeting! Try asking yourself - all these souls, all these Sparks - where are they from?

Yes, yes, clones have also been resurrected... And it should be confusing... Having the knowledge of the original, I understand that all this does not really fit with what you know... Am I just a copy?

When I came to this city ten days ago, I of course decided to take a role. The best thing would be no role at all - just my own face, right? There is nothing more cunning than your own face, because no one will believe it.
I always carry pistols with me, because I don't intend to suffer an insult for which I can't demand satisfaction...
I believe that true fearlessness is in the soul, not the heart. He who has it in the soul undoubtedly has a brave heart as well.

How was it I did not see that lofty sky before? And how happy I am to have found it at last! Yes! All is vanity, all falsehood, except that infinite sky. There is nothing, nothing, but that. There is nothing but quiet and peace.

There is not a man in the world over whom the past has acquired such a power as over me. Every recollection of bygone grief or joy strikes my soul with morbid effect, and draws forth ever the same sounds... I am stupidly constituted: I forget nothing. Nothing!
Oh, my stomach hurts... And my legs... State service is hard - I'm always at my post. I want to go home! I need a vacation...
Our fortress has everything, if they deliver it on time... But, of course, we don't always have enough supplies - the surrounding lands are too barren...

quests: Good Deeds for the City: Meals for Soldiers

t: I'm a poor widow who lives by letting rooms. I make enough on my chickens and eggs to buy some clothes for the children.
Work gives form, and completeness, and a purpose to life.
Eh, Zakhar is grumbling, but I wanted to help: put it all in different places so the tea shouldn't smell of soap... and he is angry.
But can one happiness be followed by another and then by a third just like it?
Tensess gave me an apprentice, a boyar's son. I've been fighting with him for three years now: he can't count to three...

The police can't handle it, we should bring in the Guard! Troublemakers used to throw punches at us, but we could punch back - and that would calm them down! But now they are armed with axes and pitchforks - we can't fight that.
Delivering urgent dispatches to and from the palace is my first priority! Fast legs are the best remedy against the corrupted!
Ah, the romantic atmosphere of a casino! Beautiful! But all I do is deliver promissory notes...
If I learn the secret of three cards, I'll become rich and marry Lisa!
I think I'll go back to the swamp and continue my research of the ghostly fauna... I don't understand how long I'll have to play this role.
Yes, I feel sorry for our countess! She trusted me, and she said so: you, Slap, are my faithful shield! I don't know if Herman and Lisa will need my services, hah.
You can't escape the prophecy! I made a mistake when I agreed to Elleken's terms, and now I'm paying for it...

How wonderful it is to be alive again after spending so long as a disembodied shadow! There is truly high society here on Jigran! Look at the Elves, the rulers of Tlavia and Everia! Ah, today I will stay here in this casino, and tomorrow I will join an orgy! I love orgies!

Ah, Everia! What is Everia, you ask? The most beautiful of the states that existed in Sarnaut... We founded it on the shores of the eastern seas, having recaptured the ethereal steppes from the Orcs. Humans and elves have come together as one people to build the most beautiful cities drowned in flowers...

Alas, we had evil and envious neighbors! The insidious Tlavia, the land of rainy hills, decided that we should submit to its rulers... For many years we fought for our independence, but in the end Tlavia managed to break the resistance of our knights and captured Everia.
May God prolong your life and that of the new couple, and give you numerous offspring, grandchildren and great-grandchildren!
I am different. What can I say? I do not wish for another life, and I cannot wish for it, because I do not know any other life.

Many have resurrected, and so have I. Some unknown force brought me here, to Jigran. I have heard of this allod. In my time it was held by Kania; there were Valir fortresses and the Emperor's own summer palaces here. The main one was in Sadrok, but then Nezeb came with fire and sword, and the fortresses fell...And a dark villain named Firez, from the Junes, showed up.

Now they say they have cleaned out the necromantic filth, restored the palaces, planted gardens... I should visit it since I can't return to Umoir.

I shall try my best to deserve a good opinion of worthy people. But how shall I escape the spite of those who will see that I'm avoiding them? Is it not possible to find means to keep everybody in the world from wishing me harm? Is it possible that there are such miserable people in the world, in whom a bad feeling is born from the fact that there is good in others. A virtuous man should take pity on such unfortunates.

The secret of three cards? Yes, I've heard of it... I owe my wealth partly to it, but believe me – a man should not seek the patronage of Luck. Because there is Fate and there is Luck - and these ladies are quite different: if Fate has the right plan for you, then Luck... Luck is changeable like the moon, creating or destroying; it interrupts the movement of life, it casts down or exalts. Reason is unable to comprehend luck, poverty or wealth – everything is unreliable...
Next year I will take my son to the palace for the benefit of the state, so do me a favor, give him your patronage...

The doctor told me yesterday, "Your body is completely poisoned by alcohol..." My name on stage is Sverchkov-Zavolzhsky... no one knows this, no one! I don't have a name here... Do you understand how upsetting it is to lose a name? Even dogs have names...

Do you really need my advice? After all, you know that I once made a big and tragic mistake - the Great Astral Campaign was Sarn's trap. Should I play the gods' games?

But listen to Nezeb - he saw a lot there, in the Heart of the World. The Astral brought us news of everything that was happening, so we know a lot.

The God of Darkness imagined himself as a Director pulling the strings, but his arrogance prevented him from seeing the true puppeteer. Now it seems to me... there is a blind spot around you. Someone close to you interfered with your destiny.

Find out what's going on...
Why don't people fly! Why don't people fly like birds? Sometimes I think I'm a bird. When you stand on a mountain, you just want to fly. I would run up, raise my arms and fly.
The harshness of the nature around us makes people harsher! I love our woods, even though they're dangerous.

Powerful magic, when it becomes too great, always leads to unusual phenomena – and this storm is one example of such. They say when Tep and the mechanics of Zem were fighting, a similar storm occurred...
A few more weeks of oatmeal for breakfast and I swear I'll howl like that dog!

My grandmother died and left a will for Uncle to pay us when we come of age, but only on the condition that we would be respectful to him... And he keeps cursing us. He scolds us in every possible way. He'll probably give us nothing in the end... Or a tiny sum...

I'm a simple man, not a knight or a count. I once held a mill, and I was also a clerk in the office...
I haven't stolen anything in seven years...
Our coats should not fall in tatters! Our shoes should last the whole journey..
We don't have enough men here... to teach Dikin a lesson. He's so rude...
No one likes false allegations! I was fierce when I was young! Now there's nothing left... It's suffocating here. I wish I could run away... I've seen little joy, but so much grief!
It's not like I'm being nosy. It's for everyone's good!
Oh shadows! Black shadows! Who are you chasing? Why? We can't catch you, black shadows!
It's true! We should drink! If we drink, we feel our strength! Sorrow will consume us if we stop drinking...! Work wouldn't get us down, trouble wouldn't get us down.

Good day! If you want to know, our university is part of the All-Sarnaut Heroic University, created at the request of Lady Catherina, so that the talents of previous eras would not be lost. And we, the teachers, came straight from the Glimor Academy of Technomagic, with the purpose of examining and training these talents!

Oh, my colleague! Or not... I have been informed of your... ahem... accomplishments in various fields. Aren't you involved in scientific research on Jigran? I mean our dear colleagues, Negus Tot and Iaver Bazar. The Arisen... They were lucky... or perhaps unlucky enough to have been resurrected earlier, in a different way, and that left its mark... Have you noticed how there are hardly any of them here? Yes, they can't survive the true resurrection, but why? That's an interesting question. Have you wondered why the Sparks returned to their bodies in the first place?

Oh, technology is our future! Will anyone argue with that? After all, Hirkalla and her rebellious sister Alice both support the development of technomagic despite it being forbidden by... what was that goddess's name? The All-Mother?

Our students are bored in Sarnaut! Everyone dreams of the Star Trails, of unknown worlds! I will tell you this – our world is the most unique. Yes, we owe this to the astral, the incredibly malleable primordial matter that gives birth to endless variations...
I have been on the bench fifteen years, and when I take a look into a report, I despair. Nezeb in all his wisdom could not tell what is true and what is not true in it.

I have been in the service thirty years. Not one merchant, not one contractor has been able to impose on me. I have dealt with one swindler after another. I have caught crooks and sharpers that were ready to rob the whole world. I have fooled three governor-generals. The governor-generals... Ah, it's not even worth talking about them.
Oh, well, what can you do? The high society is not the same these days...

Why did the Valir clan wither and die? Who knows... But you remind me of the prophecy - as long as Valir lives, Kania will not fall. Is someone trying to destroy my descendants and plunge our country into the abyss of misfortune? As the curse fell on the Valir castle, so misfortunes began to plague our Kania! But it all began here, on Jigran...

The King of Yazes is before you, my friends. I have heard about your exploits. I also know about the fate of Yazes, and I am sad. Well, you'll have to find a place for yourself in this world somehow. It's a pity that Dina, my wife, is not with me.
I heard that my domain survived the storm of past years but was neglected and became a battlefield... I will demand an answer from everyone who goes there...
We can only know that we know nothing. And this is the highest degree of human wisdom.
I do not care for rumors. Let them be!
His pen breathes love, not sparkling wit as cold as prose; whatever comes to his attention concerning Olga - that he'll mention.
Do you have a ticket for tomorrow's performance?

A world's admiration, the beauty.

Tall, rosy, well-shaped,

Proficient in each occupation,

A beauty in whatever draped.

Both hunger and cold calmly brooking.

Content, ever patient, discreet.

I oft as she mowed have been looking:

One flourish - a haycock complete!

But I do love - and I don't know why -

Her endless plains' indifference and silence,

Her endless forests' ever swaying wildness,

Her rivers' floods which, like the sea, are wide.

I love to gallop in a cart on roads,

And peering slowly through darkness of the nights,

And idly dreaming of the night abodes,

To meet the solemn hamlets' twinkling lights.

These here contiguous tribes already

Have long been feuding up to now;

Each party, be it ours or theirs,

Bent under gathering storm clouds.

Leave us alone: you're unacquainted

With suchlike bloody sacred tablets;

This family, domestic feud

Is alien, obscure to you...

Like a passing holy pilgrim

On your fields I turn my gaze,

On the outskirts of poor villages

Rustling poplars pine and fade.

Off into the open country

Down a beaten path I run.

And to meet me, light as catkins,

Peals of girlish laughter come.

You say that my country is sinful,

Your country is godless, I scream.

May the guilt still lie upon us -

We can correct and redeem.

We know what trembles on the scales,

And what we must steel ourselves to face.

The bravest hour strikes on our clocks:

May courage not abandon us!

All there is, is dawning's yellow,

All there is, is icy star,

As the years in millions pass.

Shout for joy! There is no one,

Shout for joy! There's nothing spun,

It's so black and dark, there's none

That could turn out deader ever

And could ever be more black,

Help for others will come never -

Never will you get it back.

As in a boundless sea

In darkening fields and meadows

The sunset's tristful rays fade

And then sink from sight,

The dusk is limpid, steppe is hushed,

And in mute twilights wake,

Over the steppe the shadows

Creep swiftly, bringing night.

Of all the countless stars above

I've chosen this, our world so gloomy.

And in this world I've come to love

Some cheerful pathways set before me.

And when an unexpected grief

My soul in secret starts assailing,

I peer into sky's cloudy reef

Until my soul-deep smile's unveiling.

In her presence,

A radiant glow,

A light that sets the world aglow.
Her beauty, a beacon in the night,

Shines with an everlasting light.

Seek it with a lantern

Round the moonlit globe -

You won't find that land

In any space you probe.

Emptied like a cup or saucer:

Bottom shows.

If your house is toppled,

Where's your home? God knows.

By the grace of our empress, every loyal follower can join her army and reach the appropriate rank. As an infantry general, I am also in charge of all kinds of supplies, including uniforms. If you earn our trust, I will be able to provide you with the appropriate equipment.

Of all possible creatures that could be used for cavalry, our darkest empress settled on the Jigran Vivernes - the few of those that were not affected by the distortion. These ferocious creatures are capable of making long jumps as well as biting and tearing enemies to pieces.

Anzu is not an unreasonable bird, but one of our empress's old allies. They say this Storm God once managed to steal the "tablets of fate" which made him the most powerful of the gods. However, he was defeated by other gods who split his head, so he became two-headed. Since then, he has been traveling through worlds... Perhaps he will become your companion?
